cases.explain: After the preposition на (on), the noun takes the prepositional case.
The instrumental case is used after the verb наполнить (fill) to show the means or material.
Peoples is the subject of the verb ubegayut (flee), so it takes nominative case.
After во время (during/in time of), the noun takes genitive case.
The transitive verb recognize (recognize) takes a direct object in the accusative case.
The genitive case indicates possession - treasure OF Zion.

cases.sentence: Там великий Господь будет для нас местом широких ___.
cases.explain: After the noun место (place), the genitive indicates what the place contains.
The subject of the verb говорит (says) must be in the nominative case.

reading.ru: Горе тебе, разоритель, который не был разоряем!
reading.question: What is emphasized about the destroyer in this verse?
options: He has never been conquered before
reading.correct: He has never been conquered before
reading.explain: The text specifically states 'Woe to you, destroyer, who was never destroyed.'

reading.ru: Будь нашей силой каждое утро, спасением нашим во время беды.
reading.question: What does the people request from God?
reading.explain: The verse explicitly asks God to 'be our strength every morning, our salvation in time of trouble.'

reading.question: How is the Lord described?
reading.explain: The text states 'The Lord is exalted, for he dwells on high.'

reading.question: What is described as Zion's treasure?
reading.explain: The verse directly states 'The fear of the Lord is Zion's treasure.'

reading.ru: Тот, кто ходит в праведности и говорит правду, отвергает получение прибыли от притеснения.
reading.question: What does the righteous person refuse?
reading.explain: The text describes one who 'refuses to take gain of oppression,' rejecting profits from exploitation.

reading.ru: Никто из живущих на Сионе не скажет Я болен.
reading.question: What will the inhabitants of Zion never say?
reading.explain: The verse states 'No inhabitant will say I am sick.'
